name: GitHub Copilot SDK — via Foundry project endpoint
summary: Copilot SDK BYOK provider pointed at the Foundry project /openai/v1/ URL with a `{conn}/{model}` BYOM prefix in the model field.
description: The GitHub Copilot SDK (github/copilot-sdk) supports BYOK against OpenAI-compatible endpoints. If you point it at the Foundry **project-level** endpoint (`{project_endpoint}/openai/v1/`) and pass `model="{apim-conn}/{deployment}"`, Foundry should parse the prefix and route to the APIM connection the same way it does for direct Responses API calls. Auth path is static-credential only (`apiKey` or `bearerToken`), so Entra flows require a caller-managed refresh loop.
notes:
Not yet verified end-to-end. The test `test.py` builds a Copilot session against `{project_endpoint}/openai/v1/` with `wire_model="{connection}/{deployment}"` and sends a single message — run it locally to confirm the BYOM prefix survives Copilot SDK validation → JSON-RPC → CLI → Responses API.

**Endpoint gotcha:** the `byok.md` sample uses `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/`, which is the account-level AOAI endpoint and cannot see Foundry connections. BYOM prefixes 404 there. Use the project URL: `https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>/openai/v1/`.

**Auth:** use `bearer_token_provider` (a callable) so Entra tokens refresh on every request — the static `bearer_token` field would not refresh. Requires `wire_api: "responses"`.
